findings.detail: 1 object(s) written through this version: shop (1). Written by: flux. CRD certificates.cert-manager.io marks v1alpha3 served: false (it serves v1alpha2, v1), so the apiserver rejects these objects at v1alpha3. CRD versions are set by the add-on that ships the CRD, independent of Kubernetes 1.35.
findings.remediation: move these objects to cert-manager.io/v1; the apiserver rejects writes at v1alpha3
findings.title: cert-manager.io/v1alpha3 Certificate is not served by its CRD (1 object)

findings.detail: Objects may still be persisted at v1alpha3, which CRD certificates.cert-manager.io no longer serves (storage version: v1). A CRD update that drops v1alpha3 from spec.versions is rejected while status.storedVersions lists it, so the add-on upgrade that drops it fails. CRD versions are set by the add-on that ships the CRD, independent of Kubernetes 1.35.
findings.remediation: migrate every stored Certificate to the storage version v1 (kube-storage-version-migrator, the add-on's own tool such as cert-manager's cmctl upgrade migrate-api-version, or a no-op update of each object), then remove v1alpha3 from status.storedVersions (kubectl patch crd certificates.cert-manager.io --subresource=status)
findings.title: CRD certificates.cert-manager.io lists unserved version v1alpha3 in status.storedVersions

findings.detail: 2 object(s) written through this version: default (1), shop (1). Written by: argocd-controller, kubectl-client-side-apply. CRD certificates.cert-manager.io marks v1alpha2 deprecated. The CRD says: "cert-manager.io/v1alpha2 Certificate is deprecated in v1.4+, unavailable in v1.6+; use cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate". Objects may still be stored at v1alpha2 (status.storedVersions). CRD versions are set by the add-on that ships the CRD, independent of Kubernetes 1.35.
findings.remediation: move these objects to cert-manager.io/v1 before an add-on upgrade stops serving v1alpha2
findings.title: cert-manager.io/v1alpha2 Certificate is a deprecated CRD version (2 objects)
